body: Which ward buff % are you using? Is your dungeon/raid layout correct?

author: 1nc0mp3t3nc3
body:
Ward of mythril is a 75% damage absorption, ward of ortanite is 85% the walls of aaru/divine bastion give 100% ward absorption.

If you aren't Valhalla class, your default ward absorption sits around 25%

You can mix and match your ward skills, but your ward absorption will not decrease if say for example you had 100% from divine bastion and you decided to quickly pop a ward of ortanite to add 6 extra turns of ward.

Once you get past the tutorial, you will find that the game turns to ward maxing. Oh I should also mention once you start going down the paths of Anguish, sometimes you will see a debuff that says ward will have a chance to fail to protect you each turn, so be careful about which paths you choose
